ground_truth_weight_source.mlb_mechanism: MLB's run_engine_feature_drift_*.csv ships weight_pct EMPTY — the emitter passes model_weights=None. The MODEL WEIGHT column is joined by the FRONTEND at render time: markets.py _render_run_engine_drift reads model_monitor_*.json -> feature_drift[] -> weight_pct per feature name (the moneyline blend's per-feature weight, e.g. win_pct_diff 2.37%, elo_diff 2.69%). The caption says it is 'blend-weighted feature importance from the shared feature-drift analysis'.
ground_truth_weight_source.nfl_source: the NFL moneyline monitor (nfl_model_monitor_YYYYMMDD.json -> feature_drift[] -> weight_pct) — already shipped by the daily moneyline phase with real values (elo_diff 17.279, win_pct_diff 10.157, ewm_ypp_diff 13.041, ewm_net_pts_diff 12.889, ...). nfl_explainability.py reads it by target_date; weight_pct is None only where the source has no entry (null-only-where-absent, never hardcoded).

spread_depth_delta_math.rationale: NFL margin σ ≈ 13.2 vs MLB ≈ 4.5 — a -8.0 run line on MLB already reaches ~3-4% cover probability (its ±8 depth), so the NFL equivalent needs far deeper lines to cover the same probability range. The NFL grid extends to -24.0 (48 stops).
spread_depth_delta_math.delta_documented_not_flattened: MLB depth is NOT extended — the delta is documented here, not flattened
